retrievalProfile.description: A group portrait of four men in casual attire standing on a metallic surface against a bright blue cloudy sky, featuring a bold two-tone framed text block in the lower right.
triggerTerms: group of men standing on a bus roof
distressed block lettering over blue sky

recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-shot group portrait of four men standing in a staggered line on a white, weathered metallic surface. The background is a vibrant blue sky with soft white clouds. The lighting is bright and even, suggesting an outdoor daylight setting. A rectangular white frame contains two lines of heavy, distressed sans-serif text in the bottom right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Men positioned at varying depths to create a sense of camaraderie
High-contrast blue sky against the neutral tones of the clothing and foreground
Text block anchored to the lower right, overlapping the subjects' legs
coreInvariants: Bright blue sky with scattered clouds
Heavy block typography inside a thin white border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four men occupy the center and left-middle ground, scaled from waist-up to full-body depending on depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man on the far left in light denim acts as the primary vertical anchor, while the text box anchors the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the faces of the men left-to-right, then drops down to the bold text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is dedicated to the expansive sky.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky, medium saturation in the clothing, high value in the white text elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, wide sans-serif with distressed edges
letterConstructionRules: Rough, weathered texture applied to the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: Distressed 'eroded' effect on all glyph edges

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a white rectangular stroke

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color variation for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin white rectangular border framing the text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and presence
Provides the necessary blocky, industrial feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group of four men in their 30s-40s, dressed in casual country-rock attire (jeans, t-shirts), standing on the white roof of a bus or trailer. The background is a wide, bright blue sky with soft clouds. Natural daylight.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin white rectangular frame in the bottom right corner. Inside the frame, place two lines of large, extra-bold, distressed sans-serif text. The top line should be white and the bottom line should be an earthy brown.

verificationChecks: Is the text contained within a thin white frame?
Is the sky a vibrant, saturated blue?
Does the text have a weathered, distressed texture?
Are there four men in the composition?

adjustableVariables: Color of the bottom text line
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text box does not obscure the faces
Check that the distressed texture on the font looks intentional
Verify the two-tone color scheme of the text
recipe.reuseFormula: Group portrait + high-key sky background + framed distressed block typography = Country/Rock aesthetic.
